A '''codoran ring''' was a circular band worn on the [[Limb/Legends|finger]] of an individual made of [[codoran]],<ref name="SPP" /> a precious metal.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|132|Codoran}}</ref> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' take place in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bemos]], a member of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]], wore a large codoran [[Ring/Legends|ring]] on his finger during a meeting with the other Moffs and Imperial [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] on the<ref name="SPP" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="SPP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The codoran ring was first mentioned in the [[1997]] novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', the first installment of [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="SPP" />
